product.title: Chef Guided Food Tour of Pike Place Market

description.text: Tour Pike Place Market with a chef guide who introduces vendor relationships, seasonal ingredients, and behind-the-scenes market culture. Tastings highlight Pacific Northwest flavors across multiple stops in the historic market.

highlights: Chef-led Pike Place Market food tour
Multiple curated tastings across the market

start.description: Meet at the confirmed Pike Place Market meeting point listed in your booking confirmation.

end.description: Tour finishes within Pike Place Market.
